verdict.rationale: ElevenLabs documents built-in post-conversation analysis. Data collection extracts structured data points such as contact information, issue details and business data, and success evaluation assesses goal achievement against custom criteria, which covers outcomes, entities and dispositions. The pack does not show how those results reach a developer after the call; the webhook evidence describes in-call tools, not post-call callbacks. missing for 10: documented post-call webhook delivery of analysis results, API endpoint for retrieving extracted data per conversation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can extract structured data from every call — outcomes, entities, dispositions — delivered via API or webhook after the call

citations.quote: Data collection: Extract specific data points from conversations such as contact information, issue details, or any structured information
Extract structured information from conversations such as contact details and business data
Success evaluation: Define custom criteria to assess conversation quality, goal achievement, and customer satisfaction
